tutorial.title: Multiplayer visual guide
tutorial.subtitle: Follow the screenshots step by step. Hosts and guests each follow their own flow.
tutorial.host1Desc: Under My role, select I am the host. Check the room name, relay server and key, then click Launch game to enter your world.
tutorial.host1Tip: Launch the game first, then come back to create the room.
tutorial.host2Desc: You can rename the room. Keep the LANYOU Guangzhou BGP relay. The connection key is generated automatically; no need to change it.
tutorial.host2Tip: Leave the LAN port empty. It is detected automatically after you open the world to LAN.
tutorial.host3Desc: After the game starts, choose Singleplayer and enter an existing world or create a new one. Wait until the world is fully loaded.
tutorial.host3Tip: Your friends must use the same Minecraft version.
tutorial.host4Desc: Press Esc in the world, open the game menu and click Open to LAN. This is the key step that lets friends join your world.
tutorial.host4Tip: If you cannot find the button, make sure you are inside a world, not on the main menu.
tutorial.host5Desc: The default port 12345 is fine. Click Start LAN World. When you return to the launcher, the same port is filled in automatically.
tutorial.host5Tip: Do not change the port unless you also change it to the same value in the game.
tutorial.host6Desc: The chat shows Local game hosted on port [12345]. The LAN port in the launcher must match this number exactly, or friends cannot connect.
tutorial.host6Tip: A port mismatch is the most common reason multiplayer fails.
tutorial.host7Title: Create the room and share the invite
tutorial.host7Desc: Back in the launcher, click Create room. Once the status shows Connected, click Copy invite code and send it to your friend. After they connect, click Enter game with one click.
tutorial.host7Tip: The invite contains the room, key, address and port. Do not send only the address.
tutorial.guest1Title: Choose guest and paste the invite
tutorial.guest1Desc: Under My role, select I am a guest. Paste the invite code from your friend into the input and click Join room.
tutorial.guest1Tip: Do not click Launch game first. Wait until the room is connected.
tutorial.guest2Title: Wait for connection and enter the game
tutorial.guest2Desc: When the status shows Connected, go back to the launcher and click Enter game with one click. The launcher starts the game with the host address already filled in, so no manual IP typing is needed.
tutorial.guest2Tip: If the button is unavailable, make sure the room is connected and your account and version are ready.
tutorial.guest3Desc: Open Multiplayer, refresh the list and double-click the host's room. If it is not listed, click Direct Connect and enter the host address and port from the invite code.
tutorial.guest3Tip: If it still fails, ask the host to confirm the port matches the launcher.
